_comment: Manually-curated, hand-verified entries for the /legal/third-party-notices page (src/pages/ThirdPartyNoticesPage.tsx). generate-third-party-notices.ts merges these into the auto-generated list so a dependency can be disclosed BEFORE it is actually installed (e.g. one that ships via an in-flight, not-yet-merged PR) and so its notice text can carry counsel-verified detail that license-checker cannot infer from package metadata alone (unmodified-source links, LGPL/GPL text links, chunk-isolation notes). Remove an entry once the real dependency lands and the generator's auto-detected metadata is enough on its own to replace it, OR promote its detail into the generator once stable. See scripts/security/agents.md.

pending.name: libheif-js
pending.statusNote: Ships today in the client-side HEIC/HEIF image decode path, via the `heic-decode` wrapper (a production dependency in package.json, dynamically imported at src/lib/ocrWorker.ts). Corrected 2026-08-01: this entry previously read status 'pending' with a note saying the decode path was 'not yet merged to main'. That was written when the path was in flight and was already false — heic-decode 2.1.0 is a production dependency and this package is in main's lockfile — so the public notices page would have rendered 'In development — not yet shipped' for a component we actually distribute, disclaiming a live attribution obligation. See scripts/security/license-denylist.allowlist.json for the compliance rationale (unmodified, browser-only, isolated in the lazy 'vendor-heic' chunk, which vite.config.ts now really implements) and the counsel x265/encoder verification result.
pending.licenseTextNote: LGPL-3.0 incorporates the GNU General Public License v3 by reference (LGPL-3.0 §2); both texts are linked.

pending.name: jszip
pending.statusNote: Ships today in the lazy 'vendor-zip' Vite chunk, as a transitive dependency of mammoth.js (.docx text extraction on the client-side OCR path). Dual-licensed; Arkova USES IT UNDER MIT, per scripts/security/license-denylist.allowlist.json. Added 2026-08-01: because jszip is allowlist-cleared copyleft, the generator excluded it from the general list on the assumption its notice lived here — and it did not, so it received NO attribution anywhere on this page. That is the one case where the omission matters most: electing MIT is exactly what makes the MIT attribution requirement load-bearing. The generator now fails when an allowlisted copyleft dependency has no pinned notice.
pending.licenseTextNote: Used under the MIT option of the MIT-or-GPLv3 dual license. The linked file contains both license texts as published by the project.

pending.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64
pending.statusNote: Prebuilt libvips image-processing binary for the `sharp` library (darwin-arm64 platform variant). Present in Arkova's dependency lockfile only as an inert transitive dependency of @huggingface/transformers, whose browser build (the build Arkova ships) replaces `sharp` with an empty stub at publish time — this package is never imported, bundled, or executed by any shipped Arkova code, and a build of the distributed frontend artifact emits none of its code (verified by build-and-grep 2026-08-11; CTO review recorded in scripts/security/license-denylist.allowlist.json). Because Arkova does not distribute this component, no LGPL source-offer or relinking obligation is triggered by it; it is listed here for transparency.
